kept.spine: The Free Elder Council governs here by agreement and by nothing else, and almost nothing it asks of the place arrives.
A traveller says the Free Elder Council heard him out and settled nothing, while a household that sits on no council at all had the matter done before dark.

kept.spine: The affairs of the place run through the Free Elder Council, and it keeps no building, no seal and no paid hand.

kept.spine: Pressure to buy a hold here is advancing, and little stands in its way: no watch, no purse worth the name, and a council that is only the older heads agreeing. No criminal hold has been taken yet, and that is the part of it most worth checking again.
A decision here is talked over until everyone can live with it, and once it is made it stays made.
